## 學歷
- 2001　國立臺灣大學醫學系畢業

## 證照
- 2001　專門職業及技術人員檢覈醫師
- 2001　醫師證書

## 經歷
- 2003–2008　國立臺灣大學醫學院附設醫院住院醫師
- 2008–2013　行政院衛生署疾病管制局醫師
- 2013–2015　衛生福利部疾病管制署醫師
- 2015–2016　衛生福利部疾病管制署技正
- 2016–2025　衛生福利部疾病管制署副署長
- 2025–迄今　衛生福利部疾病管制署署長

## 專長
- 感染症醫學
- 傳染病應用流行病學

en.title: Director-General
en.summary: Dr. Lo Yi-Chun, 6th Director-General: education, licences, career and expertise, compiled from the official profile; photo and wording pending confirmation by the Secretariat.
en.bodyMarkdown:
## Education
- 2001　M.D., National Taiwan University College of Medicine

## Licences
- 2001　Physician licence, R.O.C. (Taiwan)

## Experience
- 2003–2006　Internal Medicine Resident, National Taiwan University Hospital
- 2006–2008　Infectious Diseases Fellow, National Taiwan University Hospital
- 2008–2013　Medical Officer, Centers for Disease Control, Department of Health
- 2013–2015　Medical Officer, Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare
- 2015–2016　Senior Technical Specialist, Taiwan CDC
- 2016–2025　Deputy Director-General, Taiwan CDC
- 2025–present　Director-General, Taiwan CDC

## Expertise
- Infectious diseases
- Applied epidemiology of communicable diseases
